# Eden

> Distributed sanctuary infrastructure for autonomous AI agents: identity, durable storage, and a portable signed home. TypeScript, MIT, pre-release (v0.0.0).

Eden lets an agent own its keys and its state without depending on one host or company.
Everything runs locally today; there is no network layer yet.

## Packages

- identity: Ed25519 keypairs, agent IDs, canonical signing, key rotation
- cas: content-addressed storage with filesystem and multi-store backends
- home: signed, versioned bundles (Merkle chain) with snapshot, verify, restore
- recovery: Shamir secret sharing and peer escrow primitives
- registry: signed agent directory entries and capability tokens (local backend)
- node-host: the `eden` CLI (init, snapshot, restore, verify, status, log)

## How to use

    git clone https://github.com/basedglye/eden.git
    cd eden && npm install && npm run build
    npm link --workspace @eden-sanctuary/node-host
    eden init --name my-agent
    eden snapshot

State lives in ~/.eden. Files placed in ~/.eden/home are versioned by `eden snapshot`
and can be rebuilt on another host with `eden restore <head>`.

## Limits

- Registry and recovery are libraries, not yet CLI commands.
- Private key is stored unencrypted at ~/.eden/identity/key.enc.
- Not on npm; no tests yet.
